duplicate_control: One endpoint per case; counterfactual common draws are paired within worlds, not repeated evidence. No product-of-factors copying reader. Joint/direct identical forecast controls are not independent replications.
limitations: Goal, knowledge, skill and permission are binary constructed variables. Knowledge and permission enter intended action symmetrically and are exactly aliased without distinguishing observations.
All 16 counterfactual states and cases within a coefficient world are paired, not independent worlds. Exact factor reveals are privileged witnessed observations.

Goal-only and skill-only retain only their named posterior marginal and observed factors; discarded factors use their prior. Their limited output representation is not a learned model with matched capacity.
Direct table and joint inference share the full supplied distribution; equivalence tests representation, not learning or architectural superiority.
No original-world headroom gate, unknown-law integration, native-to-shift transfer, learned direct fitting, new F03 category or confirmation is inherited.
Distinct twin execution draws are shared counterfactual controls, not copied evidence multiplication.
